step1_analysis.circuit_type: Switched Capacitor Bank Switch (VCO Coarse Tuning)
step1_analysis.description: A differential switch used to connect or disconnect tuning capacitors in an LC VCO tank for coarse frequency band selection. It uses NMOS transistors to ground the capacitors in the ON state and PMOS transistors to pull the nodes to a bias voltage in the OFF state to prevent forward biasing of the NMOS junctions.

paper_reference.title: A Quad-Band GSM-GPRS Transmitter With Digital Auto-Calibration

Ron_diff.description: Differential ON resistance between N1 and N2 when VDIG is high. Determines the Q-factor degradation of the LC tank.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ron = 1 / (un*Cox * W/L * (Vgs - Vth)). For W=5u, L=0.5u, Vgs=1.8V, Vth=0.42V, un*Cox=270uA/V^2, Ron_nmos ≈ 268 ohms. Total Ron_diff = R_XMA0 || (R_XMA3 + R_XMA4) = 268 || 536 = 178 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law model for SKY130 NMOS parameters.

Coff_diff.description: Differential OFF capacitance between N1 and N2 when VDIG is low. Limits the maximum frequency and tuning range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominated by Cdb of XMA0, XMA3, XMA4. Approx 1-2 fF/um of width. For W=5u, Cdb ≈ 5-10 fF per transistor. Total differential capacitance is roughly 5-15 fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical junction capacitance values for 0.5um length devices in SKY130.

Leakage_off.description: DC leakage current from the bias supply VP when the switch is OFF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold and junction leakage of the OFF NMOS transistors. Typically < 1pA for W=5u at room temperature.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected leakage for standard threshold devices in SKY130 at 1.8V.

Tuning_Range.description: VCO frequency tuning range enabled by the switched capacitor bank.

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric, depends on total tank inductance and capacitance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be simulated with just the switch subcircuit.

Phase_Noise.description: Receive-band phase noise for the high band.

sky130_expected.calculation: System level metric, depends on tank Q, active device noise, and switch Ron.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be simulated with just the switch subcircuit.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the differential ON resistance, OFF capacitance, and OFF leakage current of the VCO coarse tuning switch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Coarse Tuning Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xma3=5u L_xma3=0.5u
.param W_xma1=5u L_xma1=0.5u
.param W_xma4=5u L_xma4=0.5u
.param W_xma2=5u L_xma2=0.5u
.param W_xma0=5u L_xma0=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVP VP 0 1.8
VVDIG VDIG 0 1.8

Iac N1 N2 DC 0 AC 1

XMA3 N1 VDIG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xma3} w={W_xma3}
XMA1 VP VDIG N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xma1} w={W_xma1}
XMA4 N2 VDIG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xma4} w={W_xma4}
XMA2 VP VDIG N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xma2} w={W_xma2}
XMA0 N2 VDIG N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xma0} w={W_xma0}

.control
  * DC Analysis for Leakage
  dc VVDIG 0 1.8 1.8
  meas dc leakage_off find i(VVP) at=0
  
  * ON State AC Analysis
  alter VVDIG 1.8
  ac dec 10 100M 10G
  let vdiff_on = v(N1) - v(N2)
  let ron_diff = real(vdiff_on)
  meas ac Ron_at_1G find ron_diff at=1G
  
  * OFF State AC Analysis
  alter VVDIG 0
  ac dec 10 100M 10G
  let vdiff_off = v(N1) - v(N2)
  let zoff_imag = imag(vdiff_off)
  let coff_diff = -1 / (2 * 3.14159265359 * frequency * zoff_imag)
  meas ac Coff_at_1G find coff_diff at=1G
  
  quit
.endc
.end
